title: Best Yoga Mats in India (2026)
summary: A short list of 3 yoga mats sold in India, from budget to premium, based on shop and maker pages. Not hand-tested.
description: Yoga mat buying guide for India, 2026: three picks from budget to premium and what to check before you buy. Based on research, not hand-tested.
lead: Which yoga mat should you buy in India? Here are three picks: a thick, light mat for gentle floor work, a grippy mid-thickness mat for everyday practice, and a dense premium mat for regular practice. We have not hand-tested any of them. This guide uses shop pages, maker sites and general buying advice.

picks.name: Amazon Brand - Symactive 10mm Extra Thick NBR Yoga Mat with Carrying Strap
picks.label: Suits gentle floor work
picks.verdict: A thick, light, soft mat for gentle floor work. Check the live listing carefully before you buy.
paragraphs: This is Amazon's own-brand mat. It is made from NBR, a soft and light foam. It is 10 mm thick. The surface is textured to resist slipping, and a carrying strap comes in the pack. The listing copy says it is free from PVC, silicone and latex. That is a maker claim. The size is about 183 x 61 cm.

Here is what to know. We could not open the Amazon.in page. We used a third-party site that copies the listing, so we cannot confirm the mat is on sale today. There may be more than one Symactive 10 mm listing, so check that the product details say NBR. The weight is unclear: one copy says 750 g and another says 850 g. We could not confirm buyer ratings, warranty or the return window.
good: Thick cushioning for kneeling and gentle stretching on hard floors, according to the listing
Light for its thickness: both listed weights are under 1 kg
Sold under Amazon's own brand, so returns may follow the usual Amazon route (we did not read this listing's terms)
not_good: At 10 mm it is soft, so balance and standing poses can feel less steady
Buying guides say NBR suits fast, standing-heavy or hot yoga less well, and you may want a towel if your hands get sweaty
Buyer ratings could not be confirmed

picks.name: Kimjaly 4 mm Ultra Grippy Dynamic Yoga Mat
picks.label: Suits everyday practice
cells: PU top, rubber foam core (overseas listing)
picks.verdict: A mid-thickness mat with a grippy top and clear warranty and return terms on the Decathlon India page.
paragraphs: This is a 4 mm mat sold and shipped by Decathlon India. The product page shows the brand as Kimjaly. The yoga mat category page labels the same mat Domyos. Decathlon says 4 mm is a balance between stability and comfort. It describes the polyurethane (PU) top as very grippy. An overseas Decathlon listing suggests it for active styles such as Vinyasa and Ashtanga.

Here is what to know. The India page does not state the material, size or weight. The details we mention (PU and polyester top, rubber foam core, 185 x 65 cm, about 2.5 kg) come from Decathlon's Kuwait listing, so the India version may differ. Decathlon also warns that dust, creams and sweat can wear down the PU top over time. We could not see what buyers write in their reviews.
good: 4 mm is a middle thickness, so it is less soft for standing poses than a very thick mat
Decathlon describes the PU top as very grippy
The India page shows a 2-year warranty and 30-day returns
About 4.7 out of 5 from several hundred buyers on the decathlon.in page
not_good: About 2.5 kg on the overseas listing, so it may be heavier than a thin foam mat
The grip layer needs regular cleaning, as Decathlon itself warns
Less padding for knees on hard floors than 8 to 10 mm mats

picks.label: Suits regular practice

picks.verdict: A dense mat for regular practice. It is heavy, and the India warranty position is unclear.
paragraphs: The Manduka PRO is a 6 mm mat. The maker describes it as high-density, with floor-like stability and an easy-to-clean surface. Manduka says the surface is closed-cell, which resists moisture, and that the mat has a lifetime guarantee. The standard length is 71 inches (180 cm). There is also a shorter 68 inch and a longer 85 inch version. Manduka's own page shows thousands of reviews.

Here is what to know. Manduka's page does not name the material. The PVC detail comes from retailer descriptions, so check it on the listing. The mat seems to reach India through third-party sellers on Amazon.in and through Ubuy India, not an official Manduka India store. We could not open the Amazon.in page, so stock is unconfirmed. We could not confirm that the lifetime guarantee covers an import sold in India. India return terms are also unconfirmed.
good: Dense 6 mm build that the maker presents as stable
Closed-cell surface that the maker says resists moisture and is easy to clean
The maker advertises a lifetime guarantee
Thousands of reviews on Manduka's own page

choose.heading: Pick the thickness for your floor and poses
choose.text: Thick mats of 8 to 10 mm give more padding for knees on hard floors. They feel soft and less steady in standing and balance poses. About 4 to 6 mm is the usual middle ground.

choose.heading: Know your material
choose.text: NBR is a soft, light, thick foam sold for cushioning. Buying guides say it suits fast, standing-heavy or hot yoga less well. TPE is often described as light and soft. Natural rubber is often described as denser, with a tackier grip. These are general descriptions, not test results.

choose.heading: Read the material on the exact listing
choose.text: Some Indian listings contradict themselves. A mat may be named one material while the details say another. Read the full product details before you buy.

choose.heading: Look at the grip layer
choose.text: Grip depends on the top layer as well as the base. A PU top can be grippy, but Decathlon warns that dust, creams and sweat wear it down. Wipe it regularly. On NBR or closed-cell mats, a towel can help if your hands get sweaty.

choose.heading: Check the size if you are tall
choose.text: Manduka's PRO comes in 68, 71 and 85 inch lengths. Decathlon India's yoga mat category lists some longer mats too. We could not confirm a longer version of the Kimjaly 4 mm.

choose.heading: Check who sells it and the return terms
choose.text: Mats sold by the maker or a large shop often have clearer warranty and return terms, like the 2-year warranty and 30-day returns on decathlon.in. Third-party or cross-border sellers can differ. Confirm the terms before you rely on a brand guarantee.

faq.q: What thickness of yoga mat should I choose?
faq.a: It depends on your floor and your poses. Thick mats of 8 to 10 mm are comfier for knees but less steady for standing poses. About 4 to 6 mm is a common middle choice.

faq.q: Is an NBR mat good for hot yoga?
faq.a: Buying guides say NBR is not the best fit for fast, standing-heavy or hot yoga. If your hands get sweaty, you may want a towel. NBR suits gentle stretching and floor work better.

faq.q: How do I keep a PU-top mat grippy?
faq.a: Wipe it regularly. Decathlon warns that dust, creams and sweat can wear down the PU grip layer over time. For the Kimjaly, an overseas Decathlon listing suggests warm soapy water and a microfibre cloth, then air drying away from the sun.

faq.q: Will a brand's guarantee work if I buy from a third-party seller?
faq.a: Not always. Manduka advertises a lifetime guarantee, but we could not confirm that it covers mats sold into India through third-party or cross-border sellers. Check the terms on the exact listing before you buy.
